title: Bradford Assay with RotiQuant (ROTH) v1
objective: Construct a BSA calibration curve and quantify a diluted protein sample with RotiQuant.
scope: Selected assay module; upstream sample production may be manual or missing.

source_facts.qualifier: Concentration in prepared standards before assay reagent addition, not final well concentration.

actions.description: Prepare BSA in the sample-matched buffer and diluted RotiQuant using the explicit source recipe.
Prepare six independent 200 uL standards; these are direct dilutions, not a source-specified serial chain.
Dispense standards and diluted sample into replicate wells.
Add diluted reagent; prepare blanks and pigment controls when applicable.
Incubate, then read each well at the specified wavelength.

analysis: Blank/pigment correction; regress averaged standards; multiply interpolated sample concentration by dilution factor.
additional_equipment_and_manual_steps: manual reagent preparation and plate loading
